content: The build pipeline uses GitHub Actions to run lint, typecheck, and tests on every pull request.
构建流水线使用 GitHub Actions，在每个拉取请求上运行 lint、类型检查与测试。
ビルドパイプラインは GitHub Actions を使い、各プルリクエストで lint・型検査・テストを実行します。
PostgreSQL stores session chunks with a 1024 dimensional vector embedding for semantic search.
PostgreSQL 以 1024 维向量嵌入存储会话分块，用于语义检索。
The MCP server exposes read-only search tools and never performs writes.
MCP 服务器只提供只读搜索工具，从不执行写入。
MCP サーバーは読み取り専用の検索ツールのみを提供し、書き込みは行いません。
A database migration added the manager history tables to track fund manager changes over time.
A later migration added the freshness column to the nav snapshot table for durable NAV persistence.
The most recent migration introduced a provenance column so every NAV row records its source and fetch time.
The CLI refresh command writes validated NAV quotes into the durable snapshot table.
CLI 刷新命令把经过校验的净值报价写入持久化快照表。
Exact substring matching is used for short queries to complement the vector search.
The deadline for the quarterly report was moved to the end of August after team review.
The quarterly report deadline is now the last working day of August per the updated plan.
Only verified production releases may be deployed to the staging environment.
Only verified production releases may be deployed to the staging environment.
只有经过验证的生产版本才能部署到暂存环境。
The onboarding checklist includes verifying git identity before the first commit.
The staging environment may only receive releases that have passed the full automated test suite and been reviewed by two maintainers.
The build server caches the dependency tree to speed up incremental builds.
